title: Errors creating predictions for some models

timeline.body: We are currently investigating this issue. Cloudflare is aware of, and investigating, an issue affecting prediction creation for some models on Replicate. Customers may see requests fail with the error "Failed to create prediction." We are working to understand the full impact and mitigate this problem. More updates to follow shortly.
timeline.label: investigating

timeline.body: The issue has been identified and a fix is being implemented.
timeline.label: identified

timeline.body: A fix has been implemented and we are monitoring the results.
timeline.label: monitoring
